title: Festiva Sailing Vacations

services.name: All Yacht
services.desc: From the moment you step aboard your crewed catamaran, the yacht becomes your private retreat as you sail through the British Virgin Islands. Designed for comfort, ease, and connection to the sea, each catamaran offers a relaxed setting to enjoy every part of your seven-night sailing vacation. All accommodations feature fully air-conditioned interiors, including the main salon and each private stateroom. Individual cabin controls allow for personalized comfort, while hatches and ports provide the option to enjoy the natural Caribbean breeze while at anchor. services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: At Festiva Sailing Vacations, we’ve always been dedicated to delivering unforgettable sailing experiences through our cabin charters. Now, as part of The Catamaran Company, we’re thrilled to offer bareboat charters - giving you the freedom to captain your own adventure. Take the helm of your dream vacation with a bareboat charter, giving you complete freedom to explore. Whether you’re a seasoned sailor or prefer the ease of a skippered experience, The Catamaran Company offers a diverse fleet to suit your style, including Bali, Lagoon, Fountaine Pajot, and Nautitech catamarans ranging from 40′ to 55′.
